title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 24470 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: 1). Is it necessary to offer tarawi? Question: 1). is it necessary to offer tarawi? Answer ID: 24470 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1476/1148/B=1431) It is not wajib or obligatory rather it is sunnat-e-muakkida . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
